title: Code and derived data for repeat-number heteroplasmy in Falco biarmicus mitochondrial DNA
description: Reproducible code, compact derived candidate-read sets, diagnostic positions, read classifications, repeat-copy calls, nuclear-flank linkage results, and singleton-indel alignments supporting an analysis of mitochondrial control-region repeat-number heteroplasmy in Falco biarmicus.
